items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: The fella says, what's your name? My name is Sam Jones.

ctx.x: Yes, he said, stand on the side. I got on the side too. I'll go over this. The fella says, what's your name? My name is Sam Jones. He said, alright, you get on the side. I said, what's your name? I said, Albert Jarrell. He said, no, you get on this side. So, they arrested all the ones that didn't have their passport to send them back. That's where this song come out, I'm going home to Jamaica.
